# Correct the test grid from explicit coordinates.
G=[[1]*18 for _ in range(18)]
G[0][8]=2; G[9][0]=2
coords={4:[10],5:[10,11],6:[7,10,11],7:[7,8,9,10],8:[6,7,8,9,10],9:[7,9],10:[7,9],11:[9],12:list(range(4,11)),13:[4,5,9,10]}
for r,cs in coords.items():
    for c in cs: G[r][c]=7
# Partition off-axis pixels into 4 quadrants, place each bbox at its matching corner.
H=[[1]*18 for _ in range(18)]
# rays, from edge marker to farthest original 7 in corresponding direction; include existing markers

    H[9][c]=2

    H[r][8]=2

    for c in range(18):
        if G[r][c]==7 and (r==9 or c==8): H[r][c]=7
# quadrant point lists from original
quads={
 'TL':[(r,c) for r in range(9) for c in range(8) if G[r][c]==7],
 'TR':[(r,c) for r in range(9) for c in range(9,18) if G[r][c]==7],
 'BL':[(r,c) for r in range(10,18) for c in range(8) if G[r][c]==7],
 'BR':[(r,c) for r in range(10,18) for c in range(9,18) if G[r][c]==7],
}
for name,pts in quads.items():
    if not pts: continue
    rmin=min(r for r,c in pts);rmax=max(r for r,c in pts);cmin=min(c for r,c in pts);cmax=max(c for r,c in pts)
    rh=rmax-rmin+1; cw=cmax-cmin+1

    dest_c0=0 if name[1]=='L' else 18-cw
    dr=dest_r0-rmin; dc=dest_c0-cmin

    for r,c in pts: H[r+dr][c+dc]=7
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in H))
